definitions.short: properly, to be slack , i.e. (figuratively) to be foolish
definitions.full: H2973. yaal I. [ יָאַל ] verb be foolish (compare I. אול ) — Niph`al Perfect 3masculine plural נוֺאֲלוּ Isa 19:3 ; Jer 5:4 ; וְנֹאָ֑לוּ 50:36 ; 1 plural נוֺאַלְנוּ Num 12:11 ; — do or act foolishly: — 1 shew wicked folly = sin חָטָאנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר נוֺאַלְנוּ אֲשֶׁר חַטָּאת Num 12:11 (J); in Jer 5:4 an exhibition of this folly is ascribed to ignorance. 2 become fools , lacking insight and judgment: צֹעַן שְׂרֵי נוֺאֲלוּ Isa 19:13 the princes of Zoan have become fools (|| נֹף שָׂרֵי נִשְּׁאוּ , and, in 19:11 צֹעַן שָׂרֵי אֱוִילִים , etc.); וְנֹאָ֑לוּ אֶלהַֿבַּדִּים חֶדֶב Jer 50:36 a sword is against the praters, and they shall become fools — be shewn up as such (|| ׃ חָֽתּוּ ).
